correctness.rationale: All directed path forests have at most five arcs on six vertices. The supplied standalone exact verifier enumerates 1,817 augmented faces, checks the 844-pair acyclic matching on all 6,408 Hasse covers and calculates signed rational boundary ranks (1,23,169,444,208). Morse critical vector (1,0,3,92,32) equals the rational cellular Betti vector in positive degrees, forcing every integral Morse boundary matrix to vanish; hence the claimed integral torsion-free homology. One zero-cell, no one-cells yields simple connectivity; Hurewicz gives pi_2.

value.rationale: This complete integral homology and connectivity calculation concerns the symmetric octahedral graph, a canonical first nontrivial complete three-partite graph with both directions. A three-degree free-homology pattern is not determined by Euler characteristic, and explicitly distinguishes bidirected multipath topology from previously computed one-way bipartite, polygonal, ordinary matching and Morse complexes. The result is a motivated finite benchmark for further general/equivariant classification; no overly broad theorem is claimed.
